**Daily Devotional**

**May 17**

*8 Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory: (1 Peter 1:8 KJV)*

This was written by the Apostle Peter, who had walked and lived with Jesus for 3 years, and seen Him perform many miracles, spoke as no man had ever spoken (John 7:46), seen Him transformed on the mount (Matthew 17:1-9), and yet had denied him 3 times at the end of Jesus’ walk on earth (Matthew 26:69-75, Mark 14:66-72, Luke 22:55-62, & John 18:15-27). Paul wrote that even though they had known Jesus in the flesh, they now knew Him only in the Spirit (2 Corinthians 5:16).

Knowing Jesus in the Spirit only, and not in the flesh, is to our advantage, as we can know Him spiritually without the flesh getting in the way of our understanding (2 Corinthians 5:7). Most people would have rather been with Jesus in the flesh when He was here on the earth, but we are actually very blessed to have the Word of God tell us all about Jesus, and be able to comprehend Him in the Spiritual sense, without having His flesh get in the way, as He was ordinary looking. Study the Word of God, and get to know our Jesus better than Peter did, and you will live a life “with joy unspeakable and full of glory”. Praise God for His words in the bible.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
